name: List All Showings
description: Returns all showings that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[Id]
queryFilters.description: Filter by unique identifier of the showing. All GET requests must include a filter for [Id] (if available), or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter showings last updated at or after this date-time. All GET requests must include a filter for [Id] (if available), or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

responseFields.name: data[].AssignedUserId
responseFields.description: The AppFolio Property Manager user responsible for the showing. Reference the Users endpoint for any necessary associations.

responseFields.name: data[].LeadId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the lead associated with the showing. Reference the Leads endpoint for any necessary associations.

responseFields.name: data[].UnitId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the unit that the interested party will be shown. Reference the Units endpoint for any necessary associations.

responseFields.name: data[].StartAt
responseFields.description: The start time of the showing. The value must adhere to the ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ and the default time zone is Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

responseFields.name: data[].EndAt
responseFields.description: The end time of the showing. The value must adhere to the ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ and the default time zone is Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

responseFields.name: data[].Notes
responseFields.description: A brief informative message about the showing

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
